name: Desi Tamatar (Tomatoes)
description: Locally grown desi tomatoes, favored for their tartness in curries and chutneys.

name: Gulab & Genda Phool
description: Rose and marigold garlands and loose flowers, sourced from local flower growers for home and event use.

name: Desi Anda (Farm Eggs)
description: Free-range desi eggs from small poultry farms within the region.

name: Desi Shehad (Honey)
description: Unfiltered honey harvested from apiaries in the northern regions of Pakistan.

name: Doodh, Dahi & Makhan
description: Fresh milk, dahi (yogurt), and desi makhan (white butter) from a single regional dairy farm.

name: Tandoori Roti & Naan
description: Fresh tandoori roti and naan baked in a clay tandoor the morning of market day.

name: Dhania & Pudina
description: Fresh coriander and mint, bunched and cut to order for chutneys and garnish.

name: Chaunsa & Sindhri Aam (Mangoes)
description: Chaunsa and Sindhri mangoes sourced directly from Multan and Sindh orchards.

name: Sarson & Til ka Tel
description: Cold-pressed mustard (sarson) and sesame (til) oil, pressed in small batches with no additives.
